verdict.rationale: First-party material describes allocating spend limits with auto-enforced controls, vendor-specific cards with per-transaction limits, per-user monthly limits, and virtual cards with monthly-resetting limits, with the Team and Budgets APIs managing users, cards, and budgets. This covers the core of per-card and per-employee limit setting. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the granular control types (e.g., merchant/category restrictions, per-card policy settings), independent or hands-on corroboration of per-employee card controls.
